name: Ebyte E32 / E22 LoRa UART module

pins.name: M0
pins.notes: Mode select with M1. Both LOW = normal mode. Never leave floating

pins.name: M1
pins.notes: Mode select. Both HIGH = configuration mode

pins.name: RXD
pins.notes: UART: the part receives data here. Connect to an ESP32 TX pin (9600 baud by default)

pins.name: TXD
pins.notes: UART: the part sends data here. Connect to an ESP32 RX pin

pins.name: AUX
pins.notes: LOW while the module is busy. Wait for HIGH before sending

pins.name: VCC
pins.notes: Draws over 100 mA when sending at full power

sources.title: Ebyte E32-433T20D user manual
sources.section: Pin definition (M0, M1, RXD, TXD, AUX, VCC, GND); operating modes

sources.title: Ebyte E22-900T22D user manual
sources.section: Pin definition; same 7-pin order as E32
